title: six load and order faults of the bench's full set, and one midnight
note: basis 'shown' means shown in a session container (4 CPUs) by a probe, a planted fault or a failing-first test under added CPU load; the bench's own failing lines were not read.

findings.claim: the console timing test walked the ten real pages at warm-up 1, repeat 3, so one slow answer of a loaded runner in each of a page's two walks failed a fast page; now the shipped 10/60 for them (ruling 7167587625)
test_cloud_run's complete_run rc 1 on the bench did not reproduce in 42 runs here; a lost screenshot alone turns the run FAILED, which is the lead, not shown
test_criteria_safety's guarded-SQL test did not reproduce under load or after any other test of its file (21 orders); cause not found
the session-stop rehearsal case gave the bring-up 50 s of 1 s minutes to open the session before the cap less its margin; a bring-up 26 s slower failed it; now 2 s minutes there (ruling 7167587625)
the gateway busy test's `< 1.0` s left 0.5 s beside the product's own 0.5 s slot wait (0.764 s seen under load); now the recorded slot wait and the scaled call budget (ruling 7167587625)

alive_start in deploy/poc.sh and deploy/install.sh could leave its sleep alive holding the script's stdout and stderr when alive_stop's TERM came before s=$!, so a caller reading the output waited up to the sleep's length (2 in 200 here); the sleep's streams now go to /dev/null
test_list_demo's demo-day test failed when its run crossed the site's midnight (#1518); the day is now read before and after the run and a run that crossed it is made once more

the session-ssh rehearsal case waited 180 s for its console once in the policy set as root under CI's conditions; it passed alone three times and in the ordinary user's run; its folder was gone before it was read

the box rehearsal's SCREEN step ingested under UTC's day (date -u +%F), a day older than the box's own nightly snapshot between the site's midnight and UTC's (train 180, 18:00Z); it now takes the site's day from TB_TZ and refuses no zone
id 5's elapsed ceiling read the scaled call budget, 9.0 s in every run with coverage (CI's unit shards), where a 3 s stall, slot wait or overwait passed; now the budget as written, 3.0 s (OCR 1524-1)

alive_start's heartbeat in deploy/poc.sh and deploy/install.sh held the script's output and took a zombie script for a live one, so a caller that reads to the end before reaping waited for ever after a script that ended without alive_stop; it now ends within a second of its script (OCR 1524-2)
